digest.component_or_area: rebar init command and store bootstrapping
propositions: rebar init currently creates an orphan divergent store when the configured tickets branch fetch fails or times out, leaving no distinction between fetch failure and genuine first initialization

The init flow must probe remote branch advertisement via git ls-remote with a short timeout, cache the tri-state result (advertised, reachable-absent, or unreachable) per invocation, and share it across _mount_or_create_branch, pending_init_attaches_to_existing, ensure_store_mounted_best_effort, and _create_tracker

When the remote is unreachable or times out, explicit init and strict auto-init must fail closed with a distinct error naming the remote and branch, without creating an orphan or entering the interactive consent gate, unless --force-new-store is explicitly supplied

ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount, return without error with force_new_store=False, and allow the following strict path to reuse the cached probe result and report the actionable failure

With a reachable advertised branch but no local remote-tracking ref, a bounded fetch failure must return nonzero and create no orphan; with a reachable non-advertised branch, init must bootstrap successfully; --force-new-store only permits deliberate bootstrap when reachability cannot be established

Failure messages must name the configured remote, branch, timeout where applicable, and concrete remediation steps; an existing healthy store must remain idempotent and not invoke the advertisement probe
